title: White Tower policy bundle manifest
description: The signed manifest of a policy bundle, format whitetower.bundle.v1 (docs/contracts/module-contract-v0.1.md, section 7). The signed bytes are the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of this document, and step V4 refuses any other bytes (section 7.2), which no schema can express. It is I-JSON (section 1): step V4 refuses a member name twice and an integer of a magnitude beyond 2^53 - 1, which bounds the versions below.

language.description: cedar, the only language of v1alpha1 (section 6.7).

cedar_schema.description: The Cedar schema the policies were validated against: the profile's schema with the ToolArgs that the core generates for the bundle.

catalog.description: The agent's catalog file (section 7.7). The core always includes it, and an enforcement point decides on a bundle without one as with an empty catalog.

policies.description: Global and agent-specific policies, in no particular order. Step V1 bounds the files of a bundle, these policies, the Cedar schema and the catalog file together, at 1,000 (section 7.4), so this list has no bound of its own.

path.description: policies/<scope>/<id>.cedar, built from this entry's scope and ID: step V5 refuses any other path, which this pattern cannot tie to the entry (section 7.4).

file.description: A file of the bundle other than a policy. Step V5 refuses any other path than the one each member names.
